description: This file defines a TransactionType enum and a WalletTransaction class used for representing and manipulating financial transaction data in a personal finance or wallet application.

classes.name: WalletTransaction
classes.description: A class representing a financial transaction, including amount, type, category, note, and date. Provides methods for copying, mapping from/to database representations.

methods.name: TransactionType.asString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the TransactionType for database storage.

methods.name: TransactionType.fromString
methods.description: Parses a string from the database into a TransactionType enum.

methods.name: WalletTransaction.copyWith
methods.description: Creates an immutable copy of WalletTransaction with optional modified fields.

methods.name: WalletTransaction.fromMap
methods.description: Creates a WalletTransaction instance from a map (e.g., database row).

methods.name: WalletTransaction.toMap
methods.description: Converts a WalletTransaction instance to a map suitable for database storage.
